license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice optometry or to append the letters "O.D." or any other optometric degree to a person's name with the intent thereby to imply that the individual is a practitioner of optometry, without first securing and holding an unrevoked and unsuspended license under and as provided in this chapter.

name.quote: There shall be a board to be known as the Hawaii board of optometry, for the State.

type.quote: There shall be a board to be known as the Hawaii board of optometry, for the State. The board shall consist of seven members, five of whom shall be licensed optometrists

interval_years.quote: Each licensee shall pay a biennial license fee to the board on or before December 31 of each odd-numbered year for a renewal of the license for the biennium.

required.quote: Each licensee, on or before the date designated in each odd-numbered year, shall submit to the board proof that the licensee has met the continuing education requirement through programs recognized and approved by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: the therapeutically certified optometrist shall renew the certification with the biennial renewal of license and submit proof of satisfying thirty-six hours of continuing education in the diagnosis, treatment, and management of ocular and systemic diseases

period_years.quote: Each licensee, on or before the date designated in each odd-numbered year, shall submit to the board proof that the licensee has met the continuing education requirement through programs recognized and approved by the board.

topical_requirements.quote: submit proof of satisfying thirty-six hours of continuing education in the diagnosis, treatment, and management of ocular and systemic diseases

requirements.quote: licensure of optometrists registered and licensed under the laws of any state or territory of the United States or any other jurisdiction with qualifications for licensure which equal or exceed those of this State

credential_type.quote: Every candidate who passes all examinations required by the board and who has met all requirements for licensure shall receive from the board a license to practice optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting false, untrue, or fraudulently obtained certificates, testimony, or information, or using fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or passing an examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presentation to the board of any certificate or testimony or information which was untrue in any material respect or illegally or fraudulently obtained, or when fraud or deceit has been practiced in obtaining any license under this chapter or in passing an examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct likely to deceive or defraud the public, habits of intemperance or drug addiction, professional misconduct, gross carelessness, or negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct of a character likely to deceive or defraud the public, or habits of intemperance or drug addiction calculated to destroy the accuracy of the work of an optometrist, or professional misconduct, or gross carelessness or negligence, or manifest incapacity in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising by means of false or deceptive statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising by means of false and deceptive statements or by statements which tend to deceive or defraud

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly accepting or offering employment to practice optometry from or to unlicensed persons or corporations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly accepting or offering employment to practice optometry from, or to any person not having a valid, unrevoked and unsuspended license or from any company or corporation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or receiving price differentials, rebates, discounts, commissions, or kickbacks from dispensing opticians for referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting or receiving, directly or indirectly, any price differential, rebate, refund, discount, commission, credit, kickback, or other allowance, whether in the form of money or otherwise, from a dispensing optician for or on account of referring or sending to the dispensing optician of any intended or prospective wearer or user

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a name other than the one under which licensed or advertising that fails to clearly identify the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using any name in connection with the licensee's practice other than the name under which the licensee is licensed to practice, or using any advertising which fails to clearly identify the individual licensee or which is ambiguous or misleading as to the licensee's identity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or utilizing unlicensed individuals to perform optometric services related to refraction or visual training without direct and personal supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing or utilizing any unlicensed individual to perform optometric services in connection with refraction or visual training without directly and personally supervising the individuals in the performances of the services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the optometry chapter or rules adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating this chapter or the rules adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Utilizing pharmaceutical agents for purposes other than those specified in statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Utilizing pharmaceutical agents for purposes other than those specified in section 459-1

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to refer a patient to a licensed physician when ocular abnormality or systemic disease is discovered requiring further diagnosis or treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to refer a patient to an appropriate licensed physician upon discovery, by history or examination, that the patient evidences an ocular abnormality or symptoms of systemic disease requiring further diagnosis and possible treatment by a licensed physician

definition_quote.value: The examination, diagnosis, treatment, and management of diseases and disorders of the human visual system, the eye, and the eyelids; the employment of trial frame or trial lenses, and any objective or subjective means or methods, other than the use of surgery, including refractive or therapeutic laser surgery, but including the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, as established by the board, and the performance of non-invasive diagnostic procedures or ordering of laboratory tests related to the use of pharmaceutical agents for the purpose of examining, diagnosing, treating, and managing visual, muscular, or other diseases and disorders of the human visual system, the eye, and the eyelids; or the prescribing, fitting, or adaptation of any ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, or orthoptic exercises for the correction or relief of the visual or muscular anomalies of the human eye.
definition_quote.quote: The examination, diagnosis, treatment, and management of diseases and disorders of the human visual system, the eye, and the eyelids

value: treatment and management of diseases and disorders of the human visual system, eye, and eyelids
objective or subjective means or methods (other than surgery or laser surgery)
use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents
prescribing, fitting, or adaptation of ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, or orthoptic exercises
removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye and eyelids
methods_authorized.quote: The employment of trial frame or trial lenses, and any objective or subjective means or methods, other than the use of surgery, including refractive or therapeutic laser surgery, but including the use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents, as established by the board, and the performance of non-invasive diagnostic procedures or ordering of laboratory tests

drug_authority.value: Use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (excluding controlled substances enumerated in sections 329-14, 329-16, 329-18, 329-20, and 329-22) authorized for therapeutically certified optometrists; steroidal agents permitted; no injectable agents except for anaphylaxis
drug_authority.quote: The use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as established by the board for the treatment and management of conditions of the anterior segment of the human eye, eyelids, and lacrimal system... Therapeutic pharmaceutical agents shall not include any of the controlled substances enumerated in sections 329-14, 329-16, 329-18, 329-20, and 329-22.

surgery_prohibited.quote: other than the use of surgery, including refractive or therapeutic laser surgery

surgery_definition.value: Any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Superficial foreign bodies may be removed from the human eye and eyelids, including the removal of corneal superficial foreign bodies above Bowman's Layer.

value: non-invasive surface removal of superficial foreign bodies from the anterior segment of the human eye and eyelids
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: the non-invasive surface removal of superficial foreign bodies from the anterior segment of the human eye and eyelids is authorized only for an optometrist licensed under this chapter who meets the requirements of a therapeutically certified optometrist

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: A therapeutically certified optometrist shall not administer injectable agents except for anaphylaxis.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Any person who engages in the prescribing of visual training, with or without the use of scientific instruments to train the visual system or other abnormal condition of the eyes, or claims to be able to do so, shall be deemed to be engaged in the practice of optometry

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Therapeutic pharmaceutical agents shall not include any of the controlled substances enumerated in sections 329-14, 329-16, 329-18, 329-20, and 329-22.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as established by the board for the treatment and management of conditions of the anterior segment of the human eye, eyelids, and lacrimal system

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: The use and prescription of pharmaceutical agents and the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye and eyelid shall be granted to an optometrist licensed under this chapter who has met the requirements under sections 459-7 and 459-7.4.

tiered_license_types.quote: The board shall grant recognition as a therapeutically certified optometrist

specialty_certification_types.quote: The board shall grant recognition as a therapeutically certified optometrist; provided the optometrist has: (1) A current, unencumbered license as an optometrist in this State

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: Completed a one hundred hour board-approved course in the treatment and management of ocular diseases

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Completed one hundred hours of preceptorship under the supervision of an ophthalmologist.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: If while examining or treating a patient a licensed optometrist finds, by history or examination, any ocular abnormality or any evidence of systemic disease requiring further diagnosis and possible treatment beyond the scope of practice as defined in this section, the optometrist shall refer that patient to an appropriate licensed physician.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Employing or utilizing any unlicensed individual to perform optometric services in connection with refraction or visual training without directly and personally supervising the individuals in the performances of the services
